**Finding submitted: deviation (Rule LD).**

- **What we found:** Section 14.2.1 (¶p0750) obliges PB — our party — to pay SFJ **300% of all Development Costs** paid or incurred if SFJ terminates for PB's uncured material breach. Section 14.4.2 (¶p0792) characterises the Section 14.2 termination amounts as being "in lieu of any claim for damages," making this a breach-triggered liquidated sum payable by the customer.
- **Why it fails:** A treble multiple of funded costs is punitive and sits well beyond the fallback (a single, capped early-termination amount as the sole liquidated figure).
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** strip only the multiplier — PB repays "the Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ prior to such termination," matching the drafting already used in Section 14.2.9.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the 300% at-will fee (14.2.2) and 150% change-of-control fee (14.2.6) fall under the T4C and assignment rules; the parallel 300% amounts (14.2.5.2, 14.2.7) and 25% interest add-on (14.2.10) should be conformed if this edit is accepted. Section 14.4.2's damages cap benefits us and was left untouched.
